decisions.reason: The cobot loading system is a recent automation add-on that builds on the firm's core milling machines, fits its strategy of smarter automation, and costs little to keep offering.
The dual-table loading system is a low-risk extension of the established machine offering and supports the push toward automated, efficient production, so keeping it is sensible.
Although the dispensing machine is further from the core business, it has its own web page and won a Red Dot design award in 2024, so it is too early to withdraw it and the firm is expanding.
